notes: Court ROI derived from a permissive calibration pass rather than by eye: the near player's foot cloud spans x 0.20-0.86 y 0.67-1.00, the far player's x 0.20-0.40 y 0.55-0.68, and the courtside crowd sits at x 0.74-0.90 y 0.63-0.72 with the left-hand spectators pinned at x 0.11. Six vertices, not four, because the crowd on the right needs a near-horizontal cut above it while the far court needs a sloping baseline. The near baseline runs off the bottom of the frame, so the polygon closes on y=1.0. Source is pillarboxed: x<0.09 and x>0.905 are solid black. min_hit_confidence is 0: labelling showed 0.85 discarded 7 real hits (every one of the recall losses) and caused a real rally to be split, while removing none of the false positives that matter. play_gate_min_speed_px is 0: shuttle motion was measured and does not separate play from dead time well enough to gate on (>=4 px/frame covers 78% of play frames but also 22% of dead ones).
